course: AI Agents with Python — Beginner to Production (2026)
audience: College students and working professionals who want to become an AI Engineer / AI Agent Developer

video.length_rule: No length limit. Each module is as long as it needs to cover its full syllabus (every lesson and every sub-topic). Long modules are uploaded in as many parts as needed; a lesson is never cut between parts, and every lesson is in exactly one part.
